ns2:course.label: Realism to Expressionism
ns2:course.description: Literary, thematic, cultural, and bibliographical analysis of the major authors, works, genres, and movements in German literature from 1830 to 1920. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. May be repeated to a maximum of 6 undergraduate hours or 6 graduate hours if topic varies. Prerequisite: GER 332 or equivalent.
